At review time the worktree carries uncommitted foreign changes on two owned paths: `.github/workflows/cross-host.yml` and `tests/integration/portability/portability-workflow.test.ts` (+50). The committed test's `actionLine()` matches `@\S+` and reuses the same matched line in its `toContain` block, so committed-test-vs-committed-yml is equivalent to the run performed. No file was reverted, stashed or amended.

GATES RUN (foreground, standalone, unpiped, Windows 11 / pwsh).
1. `pnpm exec tsc -p tests/integration/portability/tsconfig.json` -> EXIT 0. Silent green is real: planting `export const qaControl: number = "not-a-number";` in that include produced `error TS2322` and EXIT 1; control file removed, `git status` clean for the dir.
2. `pnpm exec vitest run tests/integration/portability` -> EXIT 0, `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 123 passed (123)`, 0 skipped.
3. `pnpm exec vitest run tests/integration/portability/portability-workflow.test.ts` -> EXIT 0, `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 12 passed (12)`.
Counts reconcile to the delivered unit: 123 - 12 = 111 from the five clean files; committed workflow file holds 9 cases (7-entry frozen roster + 2 standalone), so the committed unit is 120 / 9 — exactly the worker's recorded figures. The +3 delta is the foreign describe block.

QA RE-DRILLS (one degree of freedom changed from the worker's, per the re-drill rail).
A. REASON-CODE SWAP (worker drilled the outcome, I drilled the code). `SOURCE_COMMIT_CODES.checkoutMismatch` -> `PORTABILITY_SOURCE_COMMIT_QA_DRILL_MISMATCH` in portability-source-contract.ts. RED, EXIT 1, `Tests 3 failed | 25 passed (28)`, at the three named arms: roster case 3, "publishes the exact checkout-mismatch refusal code and layer", and "routes a synthetic merge mismatch through the production resolver". Diff shown was exactly `- CHECKOUT_MISMATCH / + QA_DRILL_MISMATCH`.
B. HISTORICAL AUTHORITY SWAP. Sealed branch `truthClass: "UNKNOWN"` -> `"PROVEN"` (line 115, portability-historical-receipt.ts). RED at 3 arms including the nested out-of-checkout arm, whose child vitest also failed — proving that arm executes and is not decorative.
RESTORE PROOF (both targets are tracked, so `git diff` is a valid anchor). Post-restore SHA256 equals pre-drill baseline: contract 4d9bca24e82ccc19a05ecbe252861b60c9460e91fba97afbff741728724f09bb, historical d2a546e4dd92c32070a705633d43e34d8e12e893fd45daeb462f0b56fb60bafc; `git diff --exit-code` over both -> EXIT 0. Owned status returned to the two foreign-WIP entries only.

DoD.
1. PASS. `portability-evidence-pin.json` absent from the commit, `git diff --exit-code` EXIT 0, SHA256 a90c9193...1533973 unchanged. The historical reader imports no `node:child_process` (asserted in production by the test) and is proven loadable outside a Git checkout; a 06c4e9ed receipt cannot conflict with any HEAD because nothing Git-observing reads it.
2. PASS. Committed YAML parses (python yaml, EXIT 0): step 0 is `actions/checkout` with `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}`, the same literal as the job-level `MOE_PORTABILITY_SOURCE_COMMIT`; roster case asserts `occurrences(job, SOURCE_EXPRESSION) === 2`. Step `portability-source` immediately follows and hard-fails on `rev-parse --verify HEAD != declared`.
3. PASS. `resolveSourceCommit` decides only from `actualCheckoutCommit` + optional `declaredCommit`; declaration can veto, never select; every success is frozen `boundBy: "CHECKOUT"` returning the observed SHA. All refusals carry `layer: "PORTABILITY_EVIDENCE"`.
4. PASS. Frozen 3-case roster (branch / PR-head agreeing / synthetic merge mislabeled) with `toHaveLength(3)` + `toBeGreaterThan(0)`, injected values, no env reads.
5. PASS — see gates above; both legs nonzero and standalone.

RAILS. Merge bytes can never wear a head label: artifact name consumes `steps.portability-source.outputs.source_commit`, and the test asserts the raw expression is NOT used for it. Per-file caps: 249 / 152 / 24 production, 320 / 249 / 197 tests — all under 400, production at or under 250.

NOT RUN, STATED PLAINLY. I did not re-run the repo-wide root suite. Owned-path legs are green; the worker's disclosed daemon-only red (`bootstrap-services.test.ts:364`, `policy-fact-adoption.test.ts:106`) lies outside every owned path and is another row's.
